title: Companion — Diagnose and restore current selected-source reading
body:
Parent: #1212. Coordination: #1209. Follow-up to the installed operational outcome of merged #1315; #1314 remains completed.

Diagnose and, only for a demonstrated defect, restore `augnes_read_repository_work_sources` on valid prepared work. Current main is `8c302ce4e916dc317b2ba02289ce9566c204fff0`, tree `2440ca040ef9066b012d4f7ca9dd2fd5ff8c1325`. The installed copy matches source and the intended Companion is live/exact. Resume and an explicit bounded historical lookup succeed, while the current-source tool returns generic `companion_unavailable`. These observations do not establish a parser, timeout, data, installation or server cause.

One issue and one substantive Draft PR own bounded authenticated-channel diagnosis, a privacy-preserving disposable causal reproducer, the smallest justified correction, focused refusal regressions, actual MCP client → proxy → authenticated route → canonical reader readback, independent source review and exact-base/head planner-selected verification. Distinguish discovery, request/timeout, HTTP/identity/size, JSON/DTO and reader outcomes using public-safe metadata only. Preserve exact snapshot/currentness, whole selected material/provenance, withheld metadata, integrity/budget refusals and zero read-side mutation. No automatic retry/fallback, SQL access, source truncation, raised budgets or retained-data changes.

Use this issue/PR as progress while current notes remain unreadable. No production cache edits/refresh or default lifecycle restart, no candidate code against retained state, no managed or semantic execution. Preserve all historical verification evidence; historical Result Workbench HTTP500 and supervisor identity-loss remain separate. Any candidate restoration requires later separately authorized post-merge installed verification. No Ready, merge, auto-merge, deployment or next phase.
